defect: IsSyncThreadSafe and GetFileSize store b_'s result in a local used only inside assert, so NDEBUG builds get an unused-variable warning that -Werror turns into a build failure.
reason: The fix removes exactly these assert-only locals added by the change, repairing the release-build break.

defect: The batch loop computes max_log_number_in_batch from the outer `edit` instead of each `writer->edit`, so batched flush edits are ignored and log_number_ can be set wrongly.
reason: The fix replaces edit with writer->edit in exactly the lines this change added.

defect: The JNI code uses unqualified Arena and ScopedArenaIterator outside namespace rocksdb and calls MemTable::NewIterator with three arguments although it takes two, so the Java build fails to compile.
reason: The fix qualifies the names and drops the extra argument in the lines this change wrote (the MemTable constructor part repairs a later API change).

defect: The new OnTableFileCreationStarted override lacks `override` while the other overrides have it, so clang's -Winconsistent-missing-override with -Werror breaks the db_stress build.
reason: The fix only adds `override` to the method this change added.

defect: Changing WritableFile::RangeSync to take off_t while PosixWritableFile still declares RangeSync(off64_t, off64_t) breaks the override on 32-bit builds, where off_t is 32-bit (hidden virtual, compile error under -Werror, posix range sync never called).
reason: The fix reverts this changed signature to off64_t as part of repairing the 32-bit compile errors.

defect: The compaction-filter guard tests `latest_snapshot_` instead of `ikey_.sequence > latest_snapshot_`, so filters run on keys still visible to snapshots.
reason: The refactoring dropped the sequence comparison from the original compaction-job condition, and the fix restores it in this line.

defect: The debug check asserting that keys are already sorted runs even when sorted_input is false, so MultiGet with unsorted keys trips the assert.
reason: The fix adds `&& sorted_input` to the assert block this change introduced.

defect: LockFile creates the lock MemFile and inserts it into file_map_ under the unnormalized `fname` instead of the normalized `fn`, so later lookups and unlocks miss it.
reason: The fix replaces fname with fn in the lines this change added.

defect: kHostnameForDbHostId is a dynamically initialized static std::string in a public header used as DBOptions' default member initializer, so DBOptions objects built during static initialization in other translation units can copy it before it is constructed.
reason: The fix replaces the line this change added with an extern const char* to remove the initialization-order dependency.

defect: Evict now calls Next() on a shared member Random64 rand_ without any lock, a data race between concurrent evicting threads (reported by TSAN).
reason: The fix removes the rand_ member this change added and uses a thread-local Random instead.

defect: ryw_expected_values is filled only when use_txn is set, yet the check loop asserts its size equals num_keys and indexes it unconditionally, failing (and reading out of bounds) in non-transaction runs.
reason: The fix makes the size check and indexing conditional on use_txn in the lines this change added.

defect: The new call passes the size_t `files_brief.num_files - 1` to FindFileInRange's uint32_t parameter, an implicit 64-to-32 narrowing that breaks the clang -Werror build.
reason: The fix adds the cast in this newly added call.

defect: The new StatisticsImpl constructor leaves the std::atomic tickers_ array uninitialized (the old DBStatistics used zero-initialized Ticker objects), so ticker counts start as garbage.
reason: The fix zero-fills tickers_ in the empty constructor this change added.

defect: TtlIterator::value() returns a Slice that points into a temporary std::string destroyed at the end of the return statement, so callers read freed memory.
reason: The fix returns a trimmed Slice of the underlying value in place of the line this change added.

defect: error_msg holds s.ToString().c_str() from a temporary string that is destroyed immediately, so the later InvalidArgument message reads freed memory.
reason: The fix keeps the string in a local in exactly the line this change added.

defect: The C callback create_compaction_filter_v2 is declared and invoked without the void* state argument that every other C callback receives, so users cannot reach their factory state.
reason: The fix adds the state parameter to the callback signature and call this change introduced.

defect: The header-only Logv now includes port/sys_time.h and calls port:: time functions inline, which broke the build of a Meta-internal (fbcode) target that includes this header.
reason: The fix removes the port include this change added and moves the body to a new .cc file to repair that internal build/import failure.

defect: Making comparator a Customizable (AsCustomRawPtr) whose serializer ignores mutable_options_only causes the immutable comparator to be emitted in mutable-only option strings, which then fail to parse with 'option not changeable'.
reason: Before this change the kComparator option was skipped in mutable-only serialization, and the fix adds the mutable_options_only branch to the serializer this change added.

defect: munmap is called inside assert(), so NDEBUG builds never unmap and leak the mapping.
reason: The fix moves munmap out of the assert this change introduced.

defect: The new write-stall logic sets stall_active_ in ShouldStall without mu_ and EndWriteStall checks queue_.empty() outside the lock before front()/pop_front(), a data race that can crash; SetBufferSize(0) also never releases stalled writers.
reason: The fix rewrites the ShouldStall/EndWriteStall/SetBufferSize logic this change added.

defect: PinnedUsageTest never releases the handles of odd-numbered inserts or the handles returned by Lookup, leaking pinned cache entries (valgrind failure).
reason: The fix tracks and releases exactly the handles the new test leaked; this is a defect in test code added by the change.

defect: The inline InstallTimedWaitFixCallback uses SyncPoint in a header that does not include sync_point.h, and SyncPoint is not declared at all under NDEBUG, so includers built with NDEBUG fail to compile.
reason: The fix moves this function out of line with the include and a full NDEBUG guard.

defect: The change adds std::atomic<int64_t> last_log_ts (requiring C++0x, which the build treats as optional) and a StatsLogger* logger_ that the constructor leaves uninitialized, breaking non-C++0x builds and crashing c_test.
reason: The fix drops the atomic and initializes logger_ for members this change added.

defect: Writes to an unknown column family now return InvalidArgument and stop WriteBatch::Iterate, so WAL recovery fails on batches that reference a dropped column family, which used to be silently skipped.
reason: The fix adds a recovery mode that tolerates the new error path; the companion missing sequence bump on skipped entries already existed before.

defect: When MultiGetFilter fails for a later file, the loop breaks and the new `s.ok() &&` guard skips running the already queued coroutines, so their table cache handles are never released.
reason: The fix removes the `s.ok() &&` condition this change added so queued tasks always run.

defect: Read-only open now replays the WAL into the in-memory memtable (via the new GetMemTable/external_table) instead of writing L0 files, but read-only Get and NewIterator still read only SST files, so recently written values are invisible.
reason: The fix makes read-only Get/NewIterator consult the memtable (exposing NewInternalIterator here), repairing the regression this change's recovery redesign introduced.

defect: DBImplReadOnly::NewIterator dereferences options.snapshot unconditionally, crashing with the default ReadOptions whose snapshot is null.
reason: The fix falls back to the latest sequence when snapshot is null, in the line this change added (the memtable part repairs a later change).

defect: LevelFileNumIterator::value() exposes the raw bytes of a whole FileMetaData (padding, refs and other uninitialized or changing fields) as the two-level index handle, which TwoLevelIterator compares byte-wise, causing valgrind uninitialized-read errors and spurious mismatches.
reason: The fix replaces the raw FileMetaData encoding this change introduced with a small fully initialized struct.

defect: The new test compares int max_write_buffer_number with 16U and size_t block_size with 4, which signed/unsigned comparison warnings turn into a build failure on mac.
reason: The fix corrects the literal types in the test lines this change added.

defect: The fix only makes the new SetBytesPerSync/SetWalBytesPerSync tests robust (kNoCompression, 1MB values, bounded sync counts) after they failed in a no-compression run.
reason: This is a test-only change to fragile test assumptions; the change's production code (mutable bytes_per_sync) is not repaired.

defect: The new checksum switch leaves `uint32_t actual` uninitialized on the default path, triggering a maybe-uninitialized warning that -Werror turns into a build failure.
reason: The fix initializes the variable this change introduced.

defect: The fix only rearranges the sync-point dependencies and data setup of the new ShuttingDownNotBlockStalledWrites test to remove flakiness.
reason: This is a test-only fix for a flaky test; no product defect from this change is repaired.

defect: The fix makes DeleteSchedulerMultipleDBPaths also count files the delete scheduler removes directly (without the trash step) and updates the expected count.
reason: This is a test-only fix for flaky counting in the test; the production change is not repaired.

defect: ASSERT_EQ(4, props.size()) compares a signed literal with size_t, a sign-compare warning that breaks -Werror builds of db_test.
reason: The fix changes the literal to 4U in the helper this change added.

defect: The change lets DisableManualCompaction return the foreground manual compaction without waiting for the background job (shared_ptr state), so a later EnableManualCompaction can revive a compaction that should have been cancelled; the new test's sync points encode this.
reason: The fix makes the foreground thread wait for the background compaction to finish or be unscheduled, and adjusts the test dependencies this change added.

defect: The new default target_file_size_multiplier(10) replaces the previous constant 2MB target size for all levels, so file sizes, grandparent-overlap and expanded-compaction limits grow 10x per level and change compaction behaviour.
reason: The fix restores multiplier 1 in the default this change introduced, matching the previous behaviour.

defect: WriteRecoverableState numbers the cached state from versions_->LastSequence(), which with two write queues can lag the already allocated sequence, so sequence numbers can be reused or published inconsistently.
reason: The fix bases the sequence on the last allocated sequence under two write queues, correcting the reference this change introduced.

defect: `#if defined(_GNU_SOURCE) && defined(__GLIBC_PREREQ) && (__GLIBC_PREREQ(2, 12))` still parses the function-like macro call when it is undefined, breaking the build on non-glibc systems.
reason: The fix splits the condition into nested #if lines exactly where this change added it.

defect: The new log statement prints a uint64_t with %lu, a format mismatch that breaks the macOS -Werror build.
reason: The fix switches this added line to PRIu64.

defect: The new perf test prints uint64_t values with %lu, a format mismatch that breaks the macOS -Werror build of the test.
reason: The fix replaces these %lu specifiers added by this change with PRIu64.
